items.title: Vector Representation of an Alternating Quantity (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Vector Representation of an Alternating Quantity: a main subheading of 17.3 Phase of A.C., its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 91-92.

blocks.text: Alternating quantity ko ek anticlockwise rotate hote (ghoomte) hue vector se dikha sakte hain, agar yeh conditions (shartein) poori hon:

items: Vector ki length (lambai) kisi scale par alternating quantity ki peak ya rms qeemat dikhaye.
Jis instant par alternating quantity zero ho aur positive taraf barh rahi ho, us waqt vector horizontal (leta hua) ho.
Vector usi angular frequency se rotate kare jo alternating quantity ki angular frequency hai.

blocks.alt: (d) red voltage V aur green current I waqt ke saath; V apni peak par I se quarter cycle, pi/2, pehle pohanchta hai. (e) O se vector diagram: OI horizontal (current) aur OV vertical (voltage), darmiyan 90 degree ka nishan.
blocks.caption: Figure 17.5 (d), (e): (d) voltage V current I se pi/2 aage; (e) vector diagram OI aur OV, V aage 90 degree (kitab ki Figure 17.5 (d), (e) ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.text: Fig. 17.5(d) mein voltage ki wave current ki wave se 90° (π/2 rad) aage hai. Fig. 17.5(e) mein vector OI current ki peak ya rms qeemat hai, jise reference (hawala) liya gaya hai. OV voltage ki peak ya rms qeemat hai, jo current se π/2 rad (90°) aage hai. Dono vectors angular frequency ω se anticlockwise rotate karte hain.

blocks.prompt: Agar I = Iₒ sin (ωt + π/2) aur V = Vₒ sin ωt ho to kaun aage hai, aur kitna?
blocks.explanation: Current voltage se π/2 (90°) aage hai.

items: Phase θ = ωt batata hai ke cycle mein hum kahan hain.
I = Iₒ sin (θ + φ): current φ aage (lead); I = Iₒ sin (θ − φ): current φ peeche (lag).
AC quantity = anticlockwise rotate karta vector (phasor): length = peak ya rms, angular speed = ω.
